§6Chicago Pile

§aNo power, no reactor, no problem. Just graphite, fuel rods, and neutron physics.

The §bChicago Pile§f is a crude early-game breeding reactor made from drilled graphite blocks. It transmutes uranium rods into plutonium without requiring any electricity. Place graphite blocks, drill them with a §bHand Drill§f, and insert fuel rods.

§6Rod Types§f:
§b• Uranium Rod§f, breeds into plutonium, not self-sustaining
§b• Ra226Be / Plutonium§f, neutron sources to kickstart reactions
§b• Lithium Rod§f, breeds into tritium for fusion fuel
§b• Control Rod§f, blocks neutron flux when inserted

§6Neutron Mechanics§f:
• Source rods emit neutrons in rays every direction
• Optimal efficiency at §e1.5 blocks§f, max range §e5 blocks§f
• Solid blocks block rays, useful for isolating multiple piles

§6Heat§f: Caps at §e1,000°C§f before fiery meltdown. Natural cooling §e5%/tick§f. Aluminum shell adds §e1.5%§f, fans add §e2.5%§f each. Max cooling: §e11.5%/tick§f with shell plus 2 fans.

§6Depletion§f: At §e50,000§f flux, uranium transmutes into plutonium rod (neutron source, 3 flux/ray). Process in Tier 2 Anvil for reactor-grade plutonium.

§ePS:§f Keep piles thin. Stack layers and neutrons have nowhere to escape, rod heat skyrockets. A single neutron source per layer is enough.
